dropped.claim: Zscaler presents a compelling long-term opportunity at the intersection of cloud security, Zero Trust architecture, and AI, with proven ability to serve the largest enterprises and convert growth investments into substantial free cash flow ($808.2M at 30.2% margin). However, the current risk/reward argues for monitoring rather than immediate deeper commitment. Three factors justify a Watch stance: first, operating losses worsened to -$128.5M in fiscal 2025 from -$121.5M despite $500M more revenue, with management explicitly expecting continued losses, indicating the path to sustainable profitability remains unclear; second, net retention declined to 114% from 116% while management acknowledges elongating sales cycles and customer cautiousness continuing in the near term, suggesting the growth algorithm is decelerating precisely when needed to justify the valuation; third, the massive R&D investment of $672.5M (25.2% of revenue) reflects both opportunity and execution risk around new products in AI security and agentic operations whose revenue contribution remains uncertain. The business quality is high, but waiting for evidence that net retention stabilizes above 115%, that sales cycle pressure eases, or that the new R&D investments begin generating visible returns would provide a better entry point with clearer visibility to sustained profitable growth.
